summary: preinstall hook fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io `_0xNNNN` identifier scheme) and, when `bun` is not already present on the host, downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte `// @bun @bun-cjs`-compiled bundle (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) that uses a rotated string-array (`WV8StW` shift-based rotator with a `hc1jfK9` char-substitution decoder over a large hex/int array). The file has no counterpart in `src/` and is not referenced by `dist/index.js`; it is reachable only through the Bun-based execution path in setup.mjs. The combination — automatic execution on `npm install`, fetch of an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an undeclared and heavily obfuscated bundled payload that has no source-tree counterpart — is an install-time remote code execution shape that runs arbitrary author-controlled bytes on the installer's machine and bypasses Node-based scanning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
